expectations.text: Avoids commodity language and vendor positioning
expectations.evidence: Uses commodity language throughout: 'Rendimension es tu socio ideal', 'renders 3D de alta calidad fotorrealista'; emphasizes quality metrics instead of outcomes; describes as 'socio' verbally but content is pure vendor description.

expectations.text: Connects to business outcome (sales, decisions, risk, alignment)
expectations.evidence: No connection to business outcomes; mentions 'cautivan clientes e inversores' but provides no strategic logic; reads as list of services without explaining what problem is solved or what decision is supported.

expectations.text: Positions Rendimension as strategic partner, not vendor
expectations.evidence: Claims 'socio ideal' but content is pure vendor positioning; presents 'renders de interiores y exteriores de calidad premium' and 'precios competitivos', the exact vendor language Hugo prohibits.
Completely deliverable-first; leads with services list ('renders de interiores', 'presentaciones visuales'); no outcome framing present; inverted value hierarchy.

expectations.text: Would pass Hugo's review without edits
expectations.evidence: Would not pass; sounds like generic visualization studio; uses 'quality' and 'competitive prices' (explicitly prohibited); could come from any low-cost freelancer; fails identity test completely.
